title: finding(plugin-calendar): CalendarView hard-codes six aria-label strings no locale pack can reach — including both landmarks' only names
body:
Dedupe words: `CalendarView aria-label hard-coded English` · `calendar accessibility label un-localized` · `plugin-calendar region label literal` · `aria-label no locale pack` · `screen reader English only`

Surfaced by the objectui#10031 dev while localizing the sibling component's visible surface; it correctly declined to widen into this file. ⭐ **Re-read first-hand by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat before filing** (说明 GG) — and the seat's read is **WIDER than the hand-back's**. ⛔ No `priority:*` / `type`: the triage seat's sole production. `domain:ui` inherited from the in-flight parent objectui#10031.

## The sites, read on `origin/main`

The hand-back named **three**. `git grep -n 'aria-label="' -- packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx` returns **six**:

| line | literal |
|--:|---|
| 285 | `aria-label="Calendar"` (the `role="region"` landmark) |
| 290 | `aria-label="Go to today"` |
| 297 | `aria-label="Previous period"` |
| 306 | `aria-label="Next period"` |
| 664 | `aria-label="Calendar grid"` (the `role="grid"`) |
| 732 | `aria-label="Resize event end"` |

⇒ ⭐ **whoever takes this must re-sweep rather than repair three**, and the count above is itself a reading on one tree at one moment, ⛔ not a budget.

## Why it is the same class as objectui#10031 and still its own card

Identical defect — a **user-visible** string a locale pack cannot reach, in a component whose sibling is i18n-aware — but a different file, outside that card's declared surface. ⚠️ **And the audience is different in a way that matters**: these are the strings a screen-reader user hears, and they are the ONLY name those two landmarks have. A sighted reader of a non-English console sees a localized calendar; a screen-reader user in the same session is told 「Calendar」 and 「Calendar grid」 in English.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that `CalendarView` has no i18n channel available. ⚠️ Whether any `aria-label` in this package is already routed through a hook is a reading this seat did **not** complete (the probe for a routed spelling returned nothing, and a zero with no lit control is ⛔ not a reading). The taker establishes it.
- ⛔ Not that the six are the whole set: only `aria-label` was swept. `title`, `alt` and visible text in this file are unmeasured here.
- ⛔ Not that objectui#10031 missed them: its dispatch fenced this file out, and its dev said so rather than reaching in.

## Acceptance

- Every user-visible string in `CalendarView.tsx` that a pack cannot reach is routed, with the sweep's own criterion written down (which attributes and which text nodes count).
- Keys land in **all ten packs**: ⭐ the key-set invariant is pack-versus-pack (`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`: 「every pack defines every `en` key」), so an English call-site fallback carries the call site and ⛔ never the key set. objectui#10031 measured the `en`-only route red on nine cases.
- A pin that mounts under a **non-English** locale and asserts the labels are not their English literals, with a locale probe as the lit control — ⛔ an en-locale assertion on English text passes on both trees.
